serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: I always wanted to ask you something.
You: What is it?
Bot: How long have you known the landlord?
…
For a second I thought she’s gonna ask something important…
You: It's been a few years since I moved here. He was very polite at first, but as soon as hyperinflation hit he wanted to alter our deal. 
You: Well, too bad for him, but even if I wanted to give him more money, which I of course didn't, I wouldn’t afford it at the time.
You: All this economic crash bullshit must've hit him pretty hard too, but it’s not an excuse for what he does to people these days. He just goes around, looking for ways to demand more money.
You: My contract also is riddled with clauses like: ‘pay more if you have a pet’, ‘pay more if a guest stays for longer than 3 days’, ‘if something breaks you pay for it’ and so on. He was a dick, but now he’s a desperate dick.
Bot: If he’s so terrible, why not leave?
You: It’s hard to change locations with the high demand we have and I would probably need to pay a few times the amount I’m paying now. {{wi}}For a similar flat…
You: Maybe someday, if there’s some good offer we will move out.
